zh.title: 从一个问题，走近地球
zh.intro: 每个专题独立展开。选一个你想弄明白的问题，再观察、改变条件、比较结果。
zh.start: 从脚下的岩石开始，也可以直接走近冰川、古生命或海洋。
zh.boundary: 这是一张探索导览。各专题分别标记制作进度；示意、推断和真实证据在对应专题内说明。

interior.title: 地球内部与板块运动
interior.question: 脚下是什么，我们怎样用地震和岩石证据认识它？

history.title: 地球的漫长历史
history.question: 把关键变化放回漫长时间，再比较留下的证据。

life.title: 古生命与化石
life.question: 走进固定的古生态案例，对照身体复原、化石保存与证据。

rocks.title: 岩石怎样形成和改变
rocks.question: 跟着同一份岩石物质，比较碎裂、搬运、胶结、变质与熔融。

minerals.title: 矿物与晶体
minerals.question: 从手中的性质、晶面与断口，走进内部的连接方式。

ores.title: 矿石怎样变成材料
ores.question: 比较热液、风化与流水富集，再看自然赋存和材料用途。

climate.title: 冰川与冰期
climate.question: 先观察一条山谷冰川的积累、运动和消融，再走向样本与冰期记录。

systems.title: 海洋与洋流
systems.question: 比较温度和盐度，追踪表层与深层海水怎样联系。

related: 火山：从岩浆到山、岛与湖

en.title: Explore Earth through one question
en.intro: Choose one question. Observe, change a condition and compare the result in its own study.
en.start: Start with a rock at your feet, or go straight to glaciers, ancient life or the ocean.
en.boundary: This is an exploration guide. Studies have individual editorial status and explain their own evidence, inferences and illustrations.

interior.title: Inside Earth and moving plates
interior.question: What lies below our feet, and how do seismic and rock evidence help us investigate?

history.title: Earth through deep time
history.question: Place key changes in deep time and compare the evidence they left.

life.title: Ancient life and fossils
life.question: Explore specific ancient ecosystems, body reconstructions, fossil preservation and evidence.

rocks.title: How rocks form and change
rocks.question: Follow the same rock material through fragmentation, transport, cementation, metamorphism and melting.

minerals.title: Minerals and crystals
minerals.question: Connect properties, crystal faces and fractures with internal structures.

ores.title: From ores to materials
ores.question: Compare hydrothermal, weathering and water-sorting pathways, then occurrence and material uses.

climate.title: Glaciers and ice ages
climate.question: Start with accumulation, motion and loss in a valley glacier, then investigate samples and ice-age records.

systems.title: Oceans and currents
systems.question: Compare temperature and salinity, then follow connections between surface and deep waters.
